# SIMBOXPRO

> SIMBOXPRO designs and builds complete plug-in racing and flight simulators for trade fairs, brand activations and sim racing events. Each simulator ships pre-assembled in a concert-grade flight case: open it, plug in a single power connection and play. Made in Poland.

## Products

- **SIMBOX Rally (SB-R1)** — all-in-one plug-in rally cockpit: MOZA R5 Direct Drive wheel, load-cell pedals, handbrake, Playseat racing seat, 39" curved OLED display, gaming PC, soundbar. Dimensions in use: 119–176 × 65.5 × 93.5 cm. Flight case: 193.5 × 99.5 × 124 cm (194.5 × 101.5 × 139 cm with dolly), 250 kg.
- **SIMBOX F1** — formula-style plug-in racing cockpit for events.
- **SIMBOX Motion (SB-M1)** — full-motion racing simulator on a DOF Reality 6-DOF motion platform with Sparco PRO 2000 seat. Flight case: 168.5 × 97.5 × 136 cm (151.5 cm high with dolly), 270 kg.
- **SIMBOX Flight (SB-F1)** — full-motion flight simulator: 6-DOF platform, HOTAS throttle and stick, rudder pedals. Flight case: 169 × 98 × 137 cm (149.5 cm high with dolly), 280 kg.

All configurations are fully customizable — components can be swapped or upgraded to match the event and budget.

## Key facts

- Setup at an event takes minutes: no cabling, no on-site configuration.
- The closed case fits a standard L2H1 delivery van; safe for road, rail or air transport (touring-grade case, foam-lined, on a removable dolly).
- Full custom branding available: vinyl wraps, branded boot screens and in-game overlays, leaderboards, engraved panels.
- Financing available: leasing and installment plans in partnership with EFL (Crédit Agricole Group).
- Simulators are commonly rented to event agencies; market day rates for event simulators typically range from several hundred to a few thousand euro per event day.
